items.output:
To avoid a breach, every month must satisfy:

\[
\frac{NOI_t}{DS_t} \ge 1.25
\]

With constant monthly growth \(g\),

\[
NOI_t = 130(1+g)^{t-1}
\]

so for each month \(t\):

\[
130(1+g)^{t-1} \ge 1.25 \cdot DS_t
\]

The binding constraint is month 7, when debt service first becomes \$140:

\[
130(1+g)^6 \ge 1.25 \times 140 = 175
\]

\[
(1+g)^6 = \frac{175}{130} = \frac{35}{26}
\]

\[
g = \left(\frac{35}{26}\right)^{1/6} - 1 \approx 0.05078964
\]

Rounded to 4 decimal places:

\[
\boxed{0.0508}
\]
